verdict.rationale: Better Auth is code-first: its homepage says there are no dashboard clicks and auth lives in code. Every capability is exposed as client methods (e.g. signUp.email, twoFactor.enable) and as server-side auth.api methods, and admin operations like creating users, managing roles, banning and impersonation sit in the admin plugin rather than a UI. Hands-on friction exists: one user found admin scripts and tests hacky because of the request-header-based design, and another found no docs for building a non-JS client. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found none on the site), documented parity for any hosted dashboard/activity features, documentation for non-JS clients, and smoother header-free server-side calls for scripting.
